cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I'll carry the heavier bag. I care more about your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then you'd appear to care more about mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if I take the side with the books.

mechanism: A copies an unfamiliar carrying maneuver as sacrifice and converts practical help into evidence of greater care.
confusable: D91 is comparative care, not D94 explicit exchange rates.
comparison: Memory preservation versus physical burden and food.
seedUse: Replace bare claims of caring more with actual comparative choices.
